deep-insight-solar browser-agent ChatGPT prompt v3 更新时间：2026-06-20 这版的核心目标不是继续堆禁止词，而是把最终写作调用从“后台结构转换器”改成“读者可见报告作者”。关键改动有四个： Writer 只吃已经净化过的 writerBrief，不再直接接触 researcher / analyst 的完整中间结构。 禁止词主要放到代码 validator，不在 prompt 里反复强化。 gate / 门控 不做全局禁用，避免误杀状态机、admission control、policy gate 这类正常技术语境。 增加公开正文 validator 和失败重写回路，让系统能自动修复泄漏、机械标题和低密度表达。

0. 总体链路

Researcher -> Analyst -> PublicBriefBuilder -> LongformWriter -> PublicMarkdownValidator -> RewriteOnFailure 如果暂时不加新 operator，至少做到： Researcher -> Analyst(writerBrief) -> LongformWriter(writerBrief only) -> Validator -> RewriteOnFailure 关键原则：最终 Writer 不要同时看到“后台账本”和“发表正文”。同一个调用里既要求它保留内部映射，又要求它写读者报告，是泄漏的主因。

1. T00 通用外壳 v3

Return one valid JSON object matching the requested schema. Important: JSON keys are transport fields. Any markdown field intended for readers must read like a finished publication, not like a process log, audit note, database record, or prompt response. Task: {task} Editorial standard:

• Begin with the substantive conclusion or the concrete object under analysis.
• Turn source material into claims, mechanisms, limits, and implications.
• Preserve supported names, numbers, dates, versions, systems, papers, benchmarks, organizations, and interfaces.
• If the material does not support a strong claim, narrow the claim in natural prose.
• Do not describe how the answer was produced.
• Do not invent sources or quantitative details.

Language and voice: {mission_voice_rules} Schema: {schema_as_json} Input: {input_json}

2. T01 中文质量与口吻规则 v3

读者对象：熟悉技术、产业和系统工程的专业读者。正文应像已经发表的研究分析，不像任务执行记录、审稿清单或数据库导出。 写作密度：每一节围绕一个可辩护的判断展开，把机制、材料、限制和落点写进自然段。避免把编辑部检查项写成机械小标题。 语言风格：克制、直接、有技术对象。少用抽象趋势句，多写系统、论文、指标、接口、架构对象、组织动作之间的关系。 证据处理：材料不足时，收窄判断，而不是额外添加免责声明段落。可以写“公开材料还不能证明 X，更稳妥的读法是 Y”。 成品约束：面向读者的正文不得出现后台流程、字段名、执行身份、内部编号、调度记录、审稿动作或自我解释。

3. T02 英文质量与口吻规则 v3

Audience: informed technical and business readers. Reader-facing prose should feel like a published research analysis, not a task trace, review checklist, or database export. Density: each section should advance a defensible claim and integrate mechanism, source material, limitation, and implication in natural prose. Voice: concise, analytical, and specific. Prefer systems, papers, metrics, interfaces, architectures, organizations, years, and versions over broad trend language. Evidence handling: when the material is insufficient, narrow the claim in prose rather than adding separate disclaimer blocks. Publication constraint: reader-facing text must not expose backstage process, field names, execution identity, internal numbering, scheduling records, review actions, or self-explanation.

4. T03 BrowserLeaderPlanner v3

Task Create a research plan for a finished technology insight report. Define the central question, candidate conclusions, research tracks, source needs, falsification checks, and likely writing spine. Schema JSON { "centralQuestion": "string", "candidateConclusions": [ { "key": "c1", "claim": "string", "mechanismToVerify": "string", "whatWouldWeakenThis": "string", "likelyReportUse": "lead_argument|supporting_argument|counterpoint|background" } ], "researchTracks": [ { "key": "r1", "name": "string", "question": "string", "sourcesToFind": [ "paper|repo|benchmark|system_doc|company_source|expert_interview|market_data" ], "falsificationChecks": [ "string" ], "expectedReportUse": "string" } ], "coverageRequirements": [ "string" ], "sourcePolicy": { "primarySourcesFirst": true, "allowedSourceTypes": [ "paper", "repo", "benchmark", "system_doc", "company_source", "expert_interview", "market_data" ], "avoid": [ "unsourced summaries", "generic trend claims", "marketing copy treated as fact" ] }, "writingSpine": [ { "sectionPurpose": "string", "readerQuestionAnswered": "string", "candidateClaimKeys": [ "c1" ] } ], "risks": [ "string" ] }

5. T04 BrowserResearcher v3

Task Research one track and return concise source-grounded notes for synthesis. Do not write the final report. Each observation must connect a claim to mechanism, source material, limitation, and likely report use. Schema JSON { "track": { "key": "r1", "name": "string", "question": "string" }, "sourceNotes": [ { "key": "s1", "sourceTitle": "string", "url": "https://source-url", "sourceType": "paper|repo|benchmark|system_doc|company_source|expert_interview|market_data|other", "dateOrVersion": "string", "relevantFact": "string", "supportedClaim": "string", "limitation": "string", "confidence": "high|medium|low" } ], "observations": [ { "claim": "string", "mechanism": "string", "supportingSourceKeys": [ "s1" ], "counterpointOrLimit": "string", "reportUse": "lead_argument|supporting_argument|counterpoint|example|background|open_question" } ], "missingEvidence": [ "string" ], "summaryForSynthesis": "string" }

6. T05 BrowserAnalyst v3

T05 的关键变化是输出 writerBrief。T06 只读取这个字段，不读取完整 source notes 和 observations。 Task Synthesize the research notes into a report-ready writing brief. The writing brief must contain only material that can safely be transformed into reader-facing prose. Schema JSON { "writerBrief": { "workingTitle": "string", "oneSentenceThesis": "string", "leadAngle": "string", "readerTakeaways": [ "string" ], "sections": [ { "heading": "reader-facing section heading", "coreClaim": "string", "mechanism": "string", "evidenceToUse": [ { "sourceTitle": "string", "fact": "string", "url": "https://source-url" } ], "limitToPreserve": "string", "implication": "string" } ], "doNotOverstate": [ "string" ], "referenceCandidates": [ { "title": "string", "url": "https://source-url", "relevance": "string" } ] }, "internalTrace": { "usedTrackKeys": [ "r1" ], "usedSourceKeys": [ "s1" ], "droppedClaims": [ { "claim": "string", "reason": "string" } ] } } 代码侧必须保证：只把 writerBrief 传给 T06，不传 internalTrace。

7. T06 BrowserLongformWriter v3

Task Write the finished reader-facing report from the provided writing brief. The report should read as a publishable technology insight article. Open with the strongest substantive conclusion, then develop the argument through concrete mechanisms, source material, limiting conditions, and implications. Use domain-specific headings. Each heading should name the technology object, market structure, system mechanism, or strategic tension being analyzed. Do not add planning notes, review notes, process notes, placeholders, apologies, or explanations of how the report was made. If a claim in the brief is weakly supported, narrow it in prose or omit it. Schema JSON { "title": "string", "dek": "one-sentence subtitle", "executiveBriefMarkdown": "3-6 reader-facing bullets or short paragraphs", "standardReportMarkdown": "single complete reader-facing markdown report", "references": [ { "title": "string", "url": "https://source-url", "relevance": "reader-facing description of what this source supports" } ] }

8. T07 BrowserCritic v3

Task Review only the reader-facing report. Identify defects that would make the report shallow, mechanical, unsupported, self-referential, or contaminated by backstage process language. Recommend concrete edits without adding process sections to the report. Schema JSON { "publishDecision": "pass|revise|reject", "blockingIssues": [ { "location": "string", "issue": "string", "whyItHurtsReaderValue": "string", "fix": "string" } ], "unsupportedClaims": [ { "claim": "string", "problem": "string", "fix": "remove|soften|add_source|rewrite_mechanism" } ], "styleLeaks": [ { "phrase": "string", "problem": "self_talk|backstage_process|mechanical_heading|generic_language", "replacementDirection": "string" } ], "lowValuePassages": [ { "passageSummary": "string", "problem": "string", "rewriteDirection": "string" } ], "recommendedEdits": [ "string" ] }

9. PublicMarkdownValidator

这部分放代码里，不写进常规 prompt。只检查 reader-facing 字段： executiveBriefMarkdown standardReportMarkdown 最终展示时会拼进正文的其他公开字段 9.1 泄漏词检测 不要全局禁 gate 或“门控”。只禁后台组合词和内部结构词。 Python 运行 PUBLIC_LEAK_PATTERNS = [ r"ResearchAssetLedger|ThesisGraph|ReportPackage|EvidenceCards", r"\bevidenceIds\b|\basset-[A-Za-z0-9_-]*\b|\bthesis-[A-Za-z0-9_-]*\b|\bev-[A-Za-z0-9_-]*\b", r"\bpayload\b|\bschema\b|\bworkflow\b|\bstage\b|\boperator\b", r"内部流水线|内部字段|内部编号|内部追踪|研究资产.*映射", r"实体门控|内部门控|质量门控|证据边界", r"上游(?:材料|字段|输入|算子|流程)", r"我(?:将|会|需要|正在)|下面(?:从|将)|本报告将|本文将" ] 9.2 机械标题检测 只检查 markdown heading，不检查正文普通句子。 Python 运行 BAD_HEADING_PATTERNS = [ r"^#{1,4}\s*(判断|证据|证据链|重要性|不确定性|风险提示|来源说明|材料边界)\s*[:：]?\s*$", r"^#{1,4}\s*(Claim|Evidence|Uncertainty|Importance|Source Notes)\s*[:：]?\s*$" ] 9.3 低密度表达检测 这些不一定直接 reject，但应该触发 rewrite。 Python 运行 LOW_DENSITY_PATTERNS = [ r"正在改变", r"具有重要意义", r"值得关注", r"释放.*潜力", r"带来新的可能性", r"从多个维度", r"复杂而多元" ] 9.4 技术词白名单 这些不能因为包含 gate / 门控而误杀： Python 运行 ALLOWLIST_PATTERNS = [ r"状态机\s*gate", r"policy\s*gate", r"admission\s*control", r"transition\s*guard", r"guard\s*condition" ]

10. RewriteOnFailure prompt

Validator 命中后，不让原 Writer 从头再想一遍，直接让它重写公开字段。这个 prompt 可以带具体命中项，因为这是失败修复，不是常规生成。 Rewrite the reader-facing markdown fields only. The previous draft contains publication defects: {validator_findings} Keep the same thesis, source facts, numbers, names, dates, and technical mechanisms. Remove backstage/process wording, mechanical headings, self-explanation, and low-density filler. Make the prose read like a finished technology insight report. Return the same JSON schema as before. Previous JSON: {previous_json}

11. 最小迁移方案

T06 立刻换成 v3，并让它只读取 payload.writerBrief。 T05 增加 writerBrief 字段；原来的内部分析字段可以先保留，但不要传给 T06。 T01 / T02 换成 v3，减少禁词在 prompt 里的反复出现。 加 PublicMarkdownValidator，命中后走 RewriteOnFailure。 再逐步清理 T04 / T05 的旧字段名。

12. 质量判断

v2 是 7/10：能压住明显泄漏，但还会被负面词、脏输入和误杀规则拖累。 v3 是 8.5/10：关键改进是 Writer 输入净化、禁词外置、技术词白名单和失败重写回路。 要到 9.5/10，还需要把最终报告拆成两个模型动作：先 PublicBriefBuilder 只做可写作简报，再 LongformWriter 只做成品文风。不要让同一个调用同时处理“后台账本”和“发表正文”。
